verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents a large browsable registry of MCP servers (100k+) and Skills (334k+) at lobehub.com/mcp and lobehub.com/skills, plus a concrete one-command install example (npx -y @lobehub/market-cli skills install ... --agent cursor) and a dedicated CLI (lhm) for publishing/installing MCP plugins, matching the story closely. missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that the install command works as advertised, and detail on one-click (non-CLI) install UX in the app itself
